name: Pit Lord's Strength adds an Annihilation charge and 3% physical damage (#1017)
contract: Pit Lord's Strength 802076 adds a flat SPELLMOD_CHARGES of +1 to Annihilation (803904, base 5 proc charges) and a native, always-on physical damage-done aura (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, misc SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL, stored bp 2 resolved 3% via the DieSides==1 +1 rule). Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone explicitly skips SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE whenever the queried damageSchoolMask includes SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL (its own comment: "mods for SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL are already factored in base melee damage calculation") because AuraEffect::HandleModDamagePercentDone already folds a physical-school aura into UNIT_MOD_DAMAGE_MAINHAND/OFFHAND/RANGED via UpdateAllDamagePctDoneMods(). The harness's melee_damage_done metric calls MeleeDamageBonusDone with the default (normal) school mask, so it structurally cannot observe this aura; it is checked at the aura's own resolved value instead.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Untalented: Annihilation keeps its base 5 charges
Talented: physical damage-done aura resolves to +3% (melee_damage_done cannot observe a physical %-done aura on this core; see contract)
